messages:
alex: Kicking off blue/green for router-service -> v2 now. Window 11:30–12:00 UTC. Initial probe at 1% traffic, then 5%, 20%. @sre-ops @kevin please watch p95 & error rates. rolling plan below.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: router-service v2.0.3. Steps: create green pool, pre-warm 4 instances, route 1% -> green, wait 10m, ramp rules applied. Runbook: /runbooks/router-bluegreen

maria: Can we confirm session affinity behavior? v2 uses new cookie name, we need header-preserving router config or users will bounce.

kevin: We'll enable cookie fallback: stickiness=route_cookie; also add header check: X-Session-V. Patch pushed to router config: `envoy.filters.http.cookie_stickiness`

liz: Health checks: liveness on /healthz, readiness on /ready with 200 + 0.1s threshold. Drain timeout 30s. If >2% 5xx in 15m, rollback.

alex: OK. Ramp steps: 1% -> wait 8m -> 5% -> wait 15m -> 20% -> wait 20m -> 50% -> finalize. Abort if p95 increases > 2x baseline or error spike.

deploy-bot: Run command executed: `rgctl rollout --service router-service --target v2 --steps 1,5,20,50 --pause 8m,15m,20m` — started at 1764501234.

sre-ops: I'll tail the SLO dashboard and set an alert if p50/p95 jump. Also enabling extra traces for the router route to v2 for 30m.

kevin: Adding temporary fallback: model variant fallback route set to v1 on 502/504. Also added metrics tag `deploy=router-v2`.

maria: Release notes snippet for visibility channel: `router-service v2.0.3: cookie-affinity fix, readiness tuning, faster KV cache warmup (10% faster).` @ops

liz: Note: This change pins internal telemetry path; if telemetry rates drop, we consider rolling back.

alex: First shift to 1% now.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift: 1% to v2 — SUCCESS. Instances warmed: 4/4. Monitoring window started.

sre-ops: Observed: p95 steady, errors flat. No increased 5xx in first 8m. Proceeding to 5% in 2 mins.

alex: Proceeding to 5%.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift: 5% to v2 — SUCCESS. Ramp timer: 15m.

kevin: Seeing a small uptick in 429s on a subset of endpoints (user-sync). I've disabled a timeout optimization flag on v2 to 100ms -> 250ms.

maria: Thanks, kevin. Any user-visible impact?

sre-ops: 429s are scoped to internal sync path, <0.3% of total requests. Not user-facing for most flows.

alex: Keep an eye. If 429s >1% or p95 > 250ms for 10m, we rollback.

liz: Logging shows readiness probe flapped on one v2 instance; I've cycled that instance out of green pool.

deploy-bot: Instance replacement: i-0a123 -> drained and terminated, new i-0b456 added.

sre-ops: After replacement, p95 normalized. Continue to 20% in 5m.

alex: Proceed to 20%.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift: 20% to v2 — SUCCESS.

kevin: I've pinned model routing for the 20% cohort to avoid feature flag mismatch. `rgctl pin --route /api/model -> v1-fallback`

maria: Reminder to add a note in the release channel: mention cookie name change + workaround for integrators.

alex: :thumbsup: Final check at 50% scheduled in 20m. If stable, we'll cut over and mark release notes done.

liz: If all good after 50%, we'll run final drain of v1 and rotate LB weights to 100%.

sre-ops: Alert: Nightly backup job started — won't affect this window. Continuing monitoring.

deploy-bot: Scheduled next step: shift to 50% at 1764503180.

alex: Thanks everyone. Ping here if you need to abort: `rgctl rollback --service router-service --to v1`.

kevin: I'll be standby to execute rollback and unpin changes if required.
